## Summary

```{r}
by(iris[, c(1, 3)], iris$Species, FUN = summary)
```

```{r}
aggregate(cbind(Sepal.Length, Petal.Length) ~ Species, data = iris, FUN = summary)
```

```{r}
x = c(1, 2, 3, NA)
sum(x)
sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)
mean(x)
mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
var(x)
var(x, na.rm = TRUE)
sd(x)
sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
```
